Central fail-closed assertion; turns any false custody invariant into a service-scoped error. Obligation: Every public operation and row validator; rejection must precede an unsafe write.

Validates workspace digest, allowed owner kind, and bounded operation ID as one admission key. Obligation: Reserve, record, claim, reconcile and handoff inputs; malformed-key tests require no verifier call or journal mutation.
Applies a labeled digest guard to request, evidence, receipt and predecessor values. Obligation: Launch, handoff and reconcile boundary validation; malformed digests must reject before effects.
Increments revision and rejects unsafe integer overflow. Obligation: Every CAS transition; boundary tests must preserve the prior row when revision cannot advance.

Creates only an absent exact schema on an unshared nontransactional DB, validates it, then requires an empty table. Obligation: Fresh initialization and invalid/shared/transactional schema inputs; no mutation of a nonempty or mismatched table.

Requires the stored table DDL to match the owned schema byte-for-byte. Obligation: Every custody route checks drift before reads/writes; altered schema must reject before receipt verification or writes.

Reads one workspace-operation row, normalizes numeric values, then validates identity, phase, evidence and handoff invariants. Obligation: Public read, reserve, claim, handoff and reconcile; corrupted persisted projections must fail closed.
Converts SQLite integer representations to the typed number fields while preserving nullable lineage. Obligation: `readRow`; tests cover int64 precision and null/non-null revision normalization.

Owns immediate transaction, commit, rollback and aggregate reporting if both body and rollback fail. Obligation: Reservation, claim and CAS writers; rollback failures must retain both causes and avoid a false commit claim.
Always attempts close/cleanup and preserves operation and cleanup errors together. Obligation: Handoff/reconcile source reads and writes; close failures and body failures remain observable.
Binds a persisted row to the exact requested workspace and operation. Obligation: `readRow`; substituted row identity must reject before any transition.
Checks request/token encodings and positive safe revision before phase-specific checks. Obligation: `readRow`; malformed persisted values reject without accepting a journal row.
Enforces owner-token and PID invariants for launching, in-flight, unknown, prepared and terminal states. Obligation: `readRow`; phase/token/PID matrix tests cover malformed persisted states.
Requires a valid digest exactly in phases that carry evidence, and null evidence otherwise. Obligation: `readRow`, close and reconcile; evidence mismatch rejects or leaves durable UNKNOWN.
Accepts only a wholly absent handoff image or a complete valid retarget lineage. Obligation: `readRow`; corrupted or partial persisted handoff lineage rejects.
Recognizes the all-null no-handoff state across six lineage fields. Obligation: `assertCustodyHandoff`; partial lineage must not be treated as absent.
Per-field predicate for the all-null lineage check. Obligation: `noHandoff`; every handoff column participates in the no-lineage case.
Conjoins owner, digest and predecessor predicates for a completed retarget. Obligation: `assertCustodyHandoff`; a handoff is accepted only when all subcontracts hold.
Restricts lineage to release-worker current ownership from release-pack-worker. Obligation: `isRetargetHandoff`; wrong-direction or wrong-owner transfer rejects.
Validates receipt, prior request and prior evidence digests as one lineage set. Obligation: `isRetargetHandoff`; malformed predecessor/receipt digest rejects.
Requires a terminal predecessor and positive safe predecessor revision. Obligation: `isRetargetHandoff`; incomplete or nonterminal predecessor rejects.
Requires the connection’s WeakMap binding to match workspace and active admission. Obligation: Reserve, record, claim and direct read; foreign or stale connections reject.

Requires exact root, relative path and workspace binding plus active admission. Obligation: Handoff/reconcile close and reopen lifecycle; a mismatched source binding rejects before close or verifier invocation.
Opens only the selected existing workspace DB and records its connection binding. Obligation: Custody callers; database lease remains paired until the matching close path.

Validates inputs/readiness, creates an ephemeral capability, stores only its digest, and reserves an absent or exact prepared row. Obligation: One-shot launch tests: no replacing UNKNOWN/terminal/launching; exact prepared beforeimage can reserve at next revision with a fresh capability.

Transaction body chooses insert versus exact prepared-state CAS, then rereads and verifies the launching reservation. Obligation: Reservation tests cover first insert, exact prepared retry, stale CAS, and no replacement of unrelated state.

Validates positive safe PID and binds it to the exact still-launching reservation by owner digest and revision CAS. Obligation: PID boundary/schema-drift tests; failed recording preserves the reservation.
Transaction body updates PID/revision and verifies the recorded launch row. Obligation: Exact launch row and CAS tests; mismatched capability or stale revision cannot bind another child.

Requires exact workspace/kind/operation/request/PID/capability match, consumes the reservation, and creates a live in-flight handle. Obligation: Claim tests require every identity component and valid child capability; claim is one-shot.

Transaction validates the complete claim image and CASes launching to in-flight while revoking launch PID/capability. Obligation: Wrong owner/request/PID/capability and concurrent/stale claims reject without consuming the wrong row.

Closes only the exact live owner by revision/token CAS; UNKNOWN has no evidence, resolved phases require a digest. Obligation: Close tests cover phase/evidence combinations, stale ownership and durable UNKNOWN on unresolved external outcomes.
Transaction body releases owner token and updates phase/evidence under the exact in-flight CAS. Obligation: Close-CAS tests ensure stale handles cannot close a successor row.
Closes the DB admission lease for an exact live handle, then deletes that handle from live ownership. Obligation: Live/non-live handle tests; handle cannot be reused after close.
Closes through admission-aware DB cleanup and removes the database binding. Obligation: All database lifecycle paths; stale connection metadata cannot be reused.
Validates key, bound connection and exact table before returning one row. Obligation: Direct read and malformed/corrupt persisted-row scenarios.

Closes the caller’s lease, holds exclusive admission, verifies exact terminal pack owner plus prepared receipt, then same-operation CASes to release-worker with lineage. Obligation: `service-operation-handoff.test.ts`: wrong owner/request/phase, verifier failure, malformed receipt, gate replacement, CAS/close failures, and exact successful handoff.
Supplies the no-op acquisition observation; the held-owner callback performs the actual exact row check. Obligation: Exclusive admission contract; no synthetic owner value grants write authority.

Exclusive handoff body verifies source row, awaits receipt, rechecks gate, then writes and rereads the exact transfer. Obligation: Successful/failed receipt and same-operation CAS scenarios; no transfer before the proof.
Reads and validates the exact terminal pack owner under the held gate. Obligation: Missing row, wrong owner/request/phase and schema drift reject before verifier call.
Closes the read-only handoff source connection with cleanup error retention. Obligation: Handoff read/close failure scenarios preserve both operation and cleanup causes.
Owns the exclusive callback’s initial read connection and returns the validated source owner. Obligation: No source write authority before receipt; gate-held exact source observation.
Closes that initial read connection through the exclusive owner. Obligation: Read-side cleanup is required on both success and failure.
Closes the write connection after the handoff CAS and row reread. Obligation: CAS/close failure tests retain the terminal or resulting exact journal state.

Reconciles only an exact same-operation launching/in-flight/unknown journal under exclusive admission using a receipt. Obligation: `service-operation-handoff.test.ts` and launch tests: wrong identity, missing row, active lease, gate replacement, malformed/failed receipt, UNKNOWN preservation and exact receipt CAS.
Captures the exact eligible source row under admission before exclusive receipt processing. Obligation: Exact owner/request/phase and missing-row tests; source DB closes before verifier effects.
Validates schema and reads the exact eligible row. Obligation: Wrong or terminal row rejects before receipt verifier invocation.
Closes the initial reconciliation read connection. Obligation: Cleanup failure remains visible; no stale lease silently survives.

Verifies prepared/terminal receipt; on uncertainty CASes to durable UNKNOWN; on valid proof CASes exact row to resolved phase. Obligation: Receipt failure and cleanup failure retention, launch revocation, UNKNOWN cleanup, exact same-operation transition and CAS tests.
Closes the connection used for UNKNOWN custody cleanup. Obligation: Failed cleanup must aggregate with receipt failure and leave effect unresolved.
Runs the resolution CAS transaction and rereads the resulting row. Obligation: Exact revision/phase CAS; trigger-deleted or stale row must reject.
Applies resolved phase/evidence and clears ownership/PID in the transaction. Obligation: Reconciliation CAS tests ensure only the exact observed same-operation row changes.
Closes the successful reconciliation write connection. Obligation: Close failure remains reported after the actual CAS; result cannot claim clean closure.

Constructs the lock-reclaim contention failure, preserving an optional underlying cause and selecting the contention or EEXIST code. Same subsystem context does not establish one-to-one lineage.

Specializes lock contention for an observed pending quarantine and records that custody remains retained. Caller review: Current reportLockFailure selects this error when a quarantine name remains. The published source has no quarantine-specific error type or constructor. Lineage: The original stale-lock paths do not construct a typed pending-quarantine failure. This constructor is a new failure classification, not the old lock contention implementation.

Represents incomplete release after an operation entered, retaining exact lock custody in its message and code. Caller review: Current release failure handling throws this type when release cleanup is incomplete. No equivalent typed release error constructor appears in the published file. Lineage: The published release paths perform cleanup but do not expose a separate error constructor distinguishing post-entry release failure from admission contention.

Represents failed restoration of a quarantined namespace while retaining quarantine custody. Caller review: Current restoreReclaimedEntry and cleanup aggregation throw this type on failed namespace restoration. The published source has no corresponding restoration error class or constructor. Lineage: The original implementation performs restoration as cleanup but does not define a separate callable that preserves the restore endpoints and cause as a typed outcome.

Resolves the target-specific native package entry and validates its package name, version, main file and exact native entry path. The published source hashes the native binary through a path under the main fs-safe package and has no target-package resolver. Matching the general name root/resolver is insufficient, and the original exact ID is not claimed.

Maps each declared top-level package manifest path into a root/relative/logical file record for a unified tree attestation. Maps package.json and fs-safe-native.node inside the resolved native package into native-target-qualified logical file records. Orders file records by their logical package path to make the attestation digest deterministic. Lineage: The published implementation sorts its flat relative-path strings with default sort and has no comparator callable over structured logical file records. Requires a still-attested package and verifies the returned binding is the module loaded from the resolved native package path.
